policy: Only approval_status=approved, licence_status=verified, and allowed_uses containing training may enter the pipeline.

corpora.name: UniversalCEFR corpus index
corpora.reason: Useful discovery index, but every subcorpus has separate terms and must be approved independently.

corpora.name: MERLIN German learner corpus
corpora.reason: Strong German learner-writing candidate; explicit project approval and attribution/share-alike plan still required before download.

corpora.name: CEFR Levelled English Texts
corpora.reason: Uploader licence claim does not by itself resolve rights and label provenance for all underlying sources.

corpora.name: TOEFL-CEFR vocabulary
corpora.reason: Vocabulary support data is not a learner-writing classification corpus; metadata and terms need verification.

corpora.name: Kaggle CELP competition reference
corpora.reason: The exact task, data files, labels, and licence have not been verified as a CEFR learner-text corpus.

corpora.name: CEFR-J English Profile
corpora.reason: Valuable controlled vocabulary/grammar reference for RAG and validation, not the primary learner-text classifier corpus.

corpora.name: DAFlex German receptive lexicon
corpora.reason: Useful German lexical feature source, but redistribution/download terms must be confirmed before ingestion.

corpora.name: Repository-generated test fixture
corpora.reason: May test pipeline behavior only; its metrics are excluded from the research dashboard.
